summary: Master the art of managing humanitarian supply chains. Join our training course to gain essential skills for effective logistics in emergency response.
lede: Humanitarian supply chain management coordinates the planning, sourcing, storage, transport, and distribution of relief goods as needs and access conditions change. For humanitarian logistics managers, procurement officers, and emergency programme leads, this course builds practical skills in needs and pipeline analysis, supplier evaluation, inventory control, route planning, and last-mile coordination through exercises in risk registers and performance dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate humanitarian supply chains, relief procurement, warehousing, transport, and field distribution. It suits intermediate to advanced learners who already work with operational plans, suppliers, logistics data, or emergency response teams and need stronger control over end-to-end aid delivery.
prerequisites: Prior experience in humanitarian operations, logistics, procurement, warehousing, transport, programme delivery, or supply chain coordination is recommended. You should be comfortable reading operational plans, supplier information, inventory records, or basic logistics reports. No programming is required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted forecasting are covered at conceptual awareness and operational application levels, not production engineering.
